rationale: The candidate reads coherently across all four views as one dominant stepped/cantilevered mass, so it avoids the one-view-only failure. The parcel is respected in a general containment sense, but the open-space figure is weak: the blue access edge is answered by a mostly sealed, elevated mass rather than a clear public void, court, or entry seam. For a gymnasium, the visible section logic should reinforce clear-span hall meaning; here the stepped roof and layered terraces read more like an abstract ziggurat than a long-span sports hall. The form is repairable and not visibly self-colliding, but the section/program relation is too sculptural and the public threshold is underdeveloped. Reference 1 and 2 support the elongated hall/bar logic; references 3 and 4 suggest a more legible ground court or sheltered threshold; the counterfactual reference is useful only as a check against over-boxy frontage.
